verses.sloka: स प्रान् मुखो राज गृहात् अभिनिर्याय वीर्यवान् ।ततः सुदामाम् द्युतिमान् सम्तीर्वावेक्ष्य ताम् नदीम् ॥२-७१-१॥
verses.transliteration: sa prān mukho rāja gṛhāt abhiniryāya vīryavān ।tataḥ sudāmām dyutimān samtīrvāvekṣya tām nadīm ॥2-71-1॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿﻿﻿ Glorious and prosperous prince Bharata, the delight of the Ikshvaku race, set out from Rajagriha, took the eastern direction, and observing the course of the river Sudama crossed Hladini and Satadru rivers which were very wide and flowing westwards crested with waves.
translations.hindi: अयोध्याकांड का अरसठवाँ सगे समाप्त हुआ । र. एकोनसप्ततितमः सगः | *, 5 बन यामेव रात्रि ते दृताः प्रविशन्ति स्म तां पुरीम्‌ । भरतेनापि तां रात्रि स्वप्नो दृष्टोऽयमप्रियः

verses.sloka: ह्लादिनीम् दूर पाराम् च प्रत्यक् स्रोतः तरन्गिणीम् ।शतद्रूम् अतरत् श्रीमान् नदीम् इक्ष्वाकु नन्दनः ॥२-७१-२॥
verses.transliteration: hlādinīm dūra pārām ca pratyak srotaḥ tarangiṇīm ।śatadrūm atarat śrīmān nadīm ikṣvāku nandanaḥ ॥2-71-2॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Glorious and prosperous prince Bharata, the delight of the Ikshvaku race, set out from Rajagriha, took the eastern direction, and observing the course of the river Sudama crossed Hladini and Satadru rivers which were very wide and flowing westwards crested with waves.
translations.hindi: राजाधिराज के पुत्र ने वह बुरा स्वप्न, रात्रि के अन्तिम पहर : में देखा था ( रात्रि. के अन्तिम पहर का देखा हुआ शुभाशुभ १ अद्देडमानाः--श्रनादरम्‌ कुर्वाणाःसादराइतियावत्‌ । (गे ०) वा० रा०--४५ स्वप्न का फल तुरन्त होता है--अतः ) भरत जी बहुत घबड़ाए हुए थे

verses.sloka: एल धाने नदीम् तीर्त्वा प्राप्य च अपर पर्पटान् ।शिलाम् आकुर्वतीम् तीर्त्वाआग्नेयम् शल्य कर्तनम् ॥२-७१-३॥
verses.transliteration: ela dhāne nadīm tīrtvā prāpya ca apara parpaṭān ।śilām ākurvatīm tīrtvāāgneyam śalya kartanam ॥2-71-3॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Bharata, ever true to his word, handsome and purehearted, reached Aparaparpata region and crossed river Satadru at Eladhana, the mountain in which river Silavaha originates. Then he traversed Salyakarsna regions in the northeast, observing the course of the Silavaha and went beyond the great mountains in the direction of the forest called Chaitraratha.
translations.hindi: उनको घबड़ाया हुआ अथवा उदास देख, उनके समवयस्क (हमजोली) अथवा उनके साथ उठने बैठने वाले तंथा प्रिययचन बोलने बाले मित्र, उनकी उदासी दूर करने को सभा में नाना प्रकार की कथाएँ कहने लगे

verses.sloka: सत्य सम्धः शुचिः श्रीमान् प्रेक्षमाणः शिला वहाम् ।अत्ययात् स महा शैलान् वनम् चैत्र रथम् प्रति ॥२-७१-४॥
verses.transliteration: satya samdhaḥ śuciḥ śrīmān prekṣamāṇaḥ śilā vahām ।atyayāt sa mahā śailān vanam caitra ratham prati ॥2-71-4॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Bharata, ever true to his word, handsome and purehearted, reached Aparaparpata region and crossed river Satadru at Eladhana, the mountain in which river Silavaha originates. Then he traversed Salyakarsna regions in the northeast, observing the course of the Silavaha and went beyond the great mountains in the direction of the forest called Chaitraratha.
translations.hindi: उनमें से कोई कोई भरत जी की उदासी दूर करने को वीणा ` बजाने लगे, कोई कोई मुक-ठुमुक नाचने या थिरकने लगे । कोईँ-कोईनाट्य करने लगे, और कोई कोई हँसाने वाले चुटकुले कहने लगे

verses.sloka: सरस्वतीम् च गङ्गाम् च उग्मेन प्रतिपद्य च ।उत्तरम् वीरमत्स्यानाम् भारुण्डम् प्राविशद्वनम् ॥२-७१-५॥
verses.transliteration: sarasvatīm ca gaṅgām ca ugmena pratipadya ca ।uttaram vīramatsyānām bhāruṇḍam prāviśadvanam ॥2-71-5॥

translations.english: ﻿ Arriving at the confluence of Saraswati and Ganga and traversing the north of Veeramatsya region, he entered the Bharunda forest.
translations.hindi: उन प्रियवचन बोलने बाले मित्रों द्वारा अनेक प्रकार से भरत जी को प्रसन्न करने के ) तु अनेक प्रयत्न किये जाने पर भी, भरत जी की उदासी दूर न हो सको !

verses.sloka: वेगिनीम् च कुलिन्ग आख्याम् ह्रादिनीम् पर्वत आवृताम् ।यमुनाम् प्राप्य सम्तीर्णो बलम् आश्वासयत् तदा ॥२-७१-६॥
verses.transliteration: veginīm ca kulinga ākhyām hrādinīm parvata āvṛtām ।yamunām prāpya samtīrṇo balam āśvāsayat tadā ॥2-71-6॥

translations.english: ﻿ He crossed the swiftflowing river known as Kulinga surrounded by hills and pleasing to the mind. Thereafter on crossing Yamuna he made his army rest on the otherside.
translations.hindi: ॥ १ आयासं --मनःखेदं । (गा०) २ लासयन्ति--लास्यंकुर्वन्त ला रयं- सुकुमारनृचं । (गो०) ३ प्रियसखः--अ्रन्तरज्ञसुदनत्‌ (गो०) । पु एकोनसप्ततितमः सगः ७०७ बैठे भरत जी से, उनके एक अत्यन्त अन्तरङ्ग हा य हम लोगों के इतना प्रयत्न करने पर भी तुम र्षित कयां नहीं होते

verses.sloka: शीतीकृत्य तु गात्राणि क्लान्तान् आश्वास्य वाजिनः ।तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च प्रायात् आदाय च उदकम् ॥२-७१-७॥
verses.transliteration: śītīkṛtya tu gātrāṇi klāntān āśvāsya vājinaḥ ।tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca prāyāt ādāya ca udakam ॥2-71-7॥

translations.english: ﻿ The weary horses rested and cooled their bodies. And they bathed and drank. They set out again refreshed taking with them a store of water.

verses.sloka: राज पुत्रः महा अरण्यम् अनभीक्ष्ण उपसेवितम् ।भद्रः भद्रेण यानेन मारुतः खम् इव अत्ययात् ॥२-७१-८॥
verses.transliteration: rāja putraḥ mahā araṇyam anabhīkṣṇa upasevitam ।bhadraḥ bhadreṇa yānena mārutaḥ kham iva atyayāt ॥2-71-8॥

translations.english: ﻿ Then with the blessed prince (Bharata) on an excellent chariot, it (the army) moved through the vast and uninhabited forest like the god of wind passing through the sky.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार इस मित्र “के पूछने पर भरत जी बोले-हे मित्र! भेरे मन के उदास होने का कारण सुनो ॥ - ॥ : स्वप्ने पितरमद्राचां मति । ले न्तमद्रिशिखरात्कलुषे गोंमयेहदे&

verses.sloka: भागीरथीम् दुष्प्रतरामम्शुधाने महानदीम् ।उपायाद्राघवस्तूर्णम् प्राग्वटे विश्रुते पुरे ॥२-७१-९॥
verses.transliteration: bhāgīrathīm duṣpratarāmamśudhāne mahānadīm ।upāyādrāghavastūrṇam prāgvaṭe viśrute pure ॥2-71-9॥

translations.english: ﻿ Bharata, the descendant of Raghu, knowing that the mighty river Bhagirathi was difficult to cross at a place known as Anshudhana, quickly reached the famous city of Pragvata.

verses.sloka: स गङ्गाम् प्राग्वट्E तीर्त्वे समायात्कुटिकोष्ठिकाम् ।सबलस्ताम् स तीर्त्वाथ समायाद्धर्मवर्धनम् ॥२-७१-१०॥
verses.transliteration: sa gaṅgām prāgvaṭE tīrtve samāyātkuṭikoṣṭhikām ।sabalastām sa tīrtvātha samāyāddharmavardhanam ॥2-71-10॥

translations.english: ﻿ With Ganga at Pragvata city and river Kutikoshtika crossed along with his army, he reached Dharmavardhana village.
translations.hindi: यह भी | देखा हें कि, महाराज तिल मिश्रित भात खा कर, बारंबार मस्तक नीचे सुकरा कर, सर्वाङ्ग में तेल लगाए हुए हें और तेल ही में डून रहे हैं

verses.sloka: तोरणम् दक्षिण अर्धेन जम्बू प्रस्थम् उपागमत् ।वरूथम् च ययौ रम्यम् ग्रामम् दशरथ आत्मजः ॥२-७१-११॥
verses.transliteration: toraṇam dakṣiṇa ardhena jambū prastham upāgamat ।varūtham ca yayau ramyam grāmam daśaratha ātmajaḥ ॥2-71-11॥

translations.english: ﻿ Having traversed the southern end of Torana, the son of Dasaratha (Bharata) reached the beautiful Varutha village via Jambuprastha.
translations.hindi: न वप्न यह देखा है कि, समुद्र सूख गया है, 440 उ वपर दार छ है, सारी एथिवो पर अंधेरा ग हे

verses.sloka: तत्र रम्ये वने वासम् कृत्वा असौ प्रान् मुखो ययौ ।उद्यानम् उज्जिहानायाः प्रियका यत्र पादपाः ॥२-७१-१२॥
verses.transliteration: tatra ramye vane vāsam kṛtvā asau prān mukho yayau ।udyānam ujjihānāyāḥ priyakā yatra pādapāḥ ॥2-71-12॥

translations.english: ﻿ He (Bharata) halted in that charming forest for a while, proceeded eastwards till he reached a place known as Ujjihana garden abounding in spriyaka trees.
translations.hindi: महाराज की सवारी के हयी के दाँतों के टुकड़े दु कड़े हो गए हैं, और प्रज्जवलित आग'सहसा बुझ गई

verses.sloka: सालाम्स् तु प्रियकान् प्राप्य शीघ्रान् आस्थाय वाजिनः ।अनुज्ञाप्य अथ भरतः वाहिनीम् त्वरितः ययौ ॥२-७१-१३॥
verses.transliteration: sālāms tu priyakān prāpya śīghrān āsthāya vājinaḥ ।anujñāpya atha bharataḥ vāhinīm tvaritaḥ yayau ॥2-71-13॥

translations.english: ﻿ After reaching the groves of sala and priyaka trees, Bharata harnessed the swiftrunning horses to the chariot and ordered his forces to proceed fast.
translations.hindi: अबतीर्णी! च एथिवीं शुष्कांश्च विविधान हसावे! अहँ पश्यामि विध्वस्तान्‌ सघूमाँख्चापि पर्वताब।॥१३)॥ थे स गयी डै और अनेक प्रकार के बृष सूख गए Do कि, पतों के ठुकड़े डुकडे हो गए हैं और उनमें से घुआँ निकल रहा हे.

verses.sloka: वासम् कृत्वा सर्व तीर्थे तीर्त्वा च उत्तानकाम् नदीम् ।अन्या नदीः च विविधाः पार्वतीयैअः तुरम् गमैः ॥२-७१-१४॥
verses.transliteration: vāsam kṛtvā sarva tīrthe tīrtvā ca uttānakām nadīm ।anyā nadīḥ ca vividhāḥ pārvatīyaiaḥ turam gamaiḥ ॥2-71-14॥

translations.english: ﻿ That tiger among men, Bharata halted at a place known as Sarvatirtha and crossed the Uttanika and various other rivers with the help of hillborn horses. He crossed the Kutika river on an elephant the river Kapivati at a place known as Lauhitya.
translations.hindi: महाराज काले लोहे के पीडे पर काले वस्न पहिने हुए बैठे हैं और काली तथा पीले रंग की ( पोशाक पहने हुए ) खनिया उनका उपहास कर रही हैं

verses.sloka: हस्ति पृष्ठकम् आसाद्य कुटिकाम् अत्यवर्तत ।ततार च नर व्याघ्रः लौहित्ये स कपीवतीम् ॥२-७१-१५॥
verses.transliteration: hasti pṛṣṭhakam āsādya kuṭikām atyavartata ।tatāra ca nara vyāghraḥ lauhitye sa kapīvatīm ॥2-71-15॥

translations.english: ﻿ That tiger among men, Bharata halted at a place known as Sarvatirtha and crossed the Uttanika and various other rivers with the help of hillborn horses. He crossed the Kutika river on an elephant the river Kapivati at a place known as Lauhitya.
translations.hindi: अबरताणा-श्रधःपतितां | ( गे० ) धर्मात्मा. महाराज लाल चन्दन शरीर में लगाए और लाल ही फूलों की माला पहिने हुए, गधों से खींचे जाने बाले -रथ में बैठे, शीघ्रतापूर्वक दक्षिण दशा की ओर चले जा रहे हैं

verses.sloka: एक साले स्थाणुमतीम् विनते गोमतीम् नदीम् ।कलिन्ग नगरे च अपि प्राप्य साल वनम् तदा ॥२-७१-१६॥
verses.transliteration: eka sāle sthāṇumatīm vinate gomatīm nadīm ।kalinga nagare ca api prāpya sāla vanam tadā ॥2-71-16॥

translations.english: ﻿ Bharata crossed the rivers Sthanumati at Ekasala and Gomati at Vinata villages. Thereafter as his horses were extremely tired he rested for a while in the sala forest in Kalinganagara before he speedily set out (again).
translations.hindi: एक विकटवदना राक्षसी, जो लालवस्न पहिने हुए है, अट्टहास करती हुई महाराज को पकड़ कर खींच रही है

verses.sloka: भरतः क्षिप्रम् आगच्चत् सुपरिश्रान्त वाहनः ।वनम् च समतीत्य आशु शर्वर्याम् अरुण उदये ॥२-७१-१७॥
verses.transliteration: bharataḥ kṣipram āgaccat supariśrānta vāhanaḥ ।vanam ca samatītya āśu śarvaryām aruṇa udaye ॥2-71-17॥

translations.english: ﻿ He passed quickly through the forest at night and at sunrise beheld the city of Ayodhya built by king Manu.
translations.hindi: मैंने रात में ऐसे भयानक स्वप्न देखे हें । इससे यह निश्चय बोध होता है कि मैं या राम या महाराज अथवा लक्ष्मण की मृत्यु होगी

verses.sloka: अयोध्याम् मनुना राज्ञा निर्मिताम् स ददर्श ह ।ताम् पुरीम् पुरुष व्याघ्रः सप्त रात्र उषिटः पथि ॥२-७१-१८॥
verses.transliteration: ayodhyām manunā rājñā nirmitām sa dadarśa ha ।tām purīm puruṣa vyāghraḥ sapta rātra uṣiṭaḥ pathi ॥2-71-18॥

translations.english: ﻿ Having spent seven nights on his way, that tiger among men (Bharata) saw Ayodhaya before him. He said to the charioteer:
translations.hindi: क्योंकि जो मनुष्य स्वप्न में गधे जुते हुए रथ पर सवार हो यात्रा करता है, थोड़े हो दिनों में उसकी चिता से घुआँ निकलता हुआ देख पड़ता है

verses.sloka: अयोध्याम् अग्रतः दृष्ट्वा रथे सारथिम् अब्रवीत् ।एषा न अतिप्रतीता मे पुण्य उद्याना यशस्विनी ॥२-७१-१९॥
verses.transliteration: ayodhyām agrataḥ dṛṣṭvā rathe sārathim abravīt ।eṣā na atipratītā me puṇya udyānā yaśasvinī ॥2-71-19॥

translations.english: ﻿ O charioteer I am able to see Ayodhya of great renown from a distance but not so clearly that whiteclaycity of Ayodhya, with its sacred gardens ruled by several rajarsis, inhabited by numerous wealthy people, by virtuous brahmins and priests who perform sacrifices and who are wellversed in the Vedas.

verses.sloka: अयोध्या दृश्यते दूरात् सारथे पाण्डु मृत्तिका ।यज्वभिर् गुण सम्पन्नैः ब्राह्मणैः वेद पारगैः ॥२-७१-२०॥
verses.transliteration: ayodhyā dṛśyate dūrāt sārathe pāṇḍu mṛttikā ।yajvabhir guṇa sampannaiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ veda pāragaiḥ ॥2-71-20॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿﻿ O charioteer I am able to see Ayodhya of great renown from a distance but not so clearly that whiteclaycity of Ayodhya, with its sacred gardens ruled by several rajarsis, inhabited by numerous wealthy people, by virtuous brahmins and priests who perform sacrifices and who are wellversed in the Vedas.
translations.hindi: इसी से मेरा कण्ठस्वर भी बिगड़ गया हे 533 pn भारी पड़ गई है, आर मेरे शारोर की कान्ति se है। मैं जानता हूँ कि, यह Es Ns डरना बुरो बात है, तो भो मेरे त मेंजो ख रे र गया है उसको दूर करने का काई उपाय सुमे. नहीं पड़ता

verses.sloka: भूयिष्ठम् ऋषैः आकीर्णा राज ऋषि वर पालिता ।अयोध्यायाम् पुरा शब्दः श्रूयते तुमुलो महान् ॥२-७१-२१॥
verses.transliteration: bhūyiṣṭham ṛṣaiḥ ākīrṇā rāja ṛṣi vara pālitā ।ayodhyāyām purā śabdaḥ śrūyate tumulo mahān ॥2-71-21॥

translations.english: ﻿ I do not hear now, in Ayodhya the tumultous noise of men and women I used to hear earlier all over.
translations.hindi: र इमां हि दुःस्वप्नगति निशम्य ता- eC मनेकरूपामवितकितां पुरा । भयं महत्तद्ध॒दयान्न यात मे - विचिन्त्य राजानमचिन्त्यदशेनम्‌रे ॥ २१ पहले कभी इस प्रकार के खोटे स्वप्न की तकता 2" नई हुई थी, किन्तु अब जब से मैंने यह खोटा स्वप्न देखा है, टु से मन में यह चिन्ता उत्पन्न हो गई दै कि, जाने प 9 दर्शन मुझे फिर हों कि नहीं ; इसी से मेरा मन अत्यन्त भय भीत हो गया है

verses.sloka: समन्तान् नर नारीणाम् तम् अद्य न शृणोम्य् अहम् ।उद्यानानि हि साय अह्ने क्रीडित्वा उपरतैः नरैः ॥२-७१-२२॥
verses.transliteration: samantān nara nārīṇām tam adya na śṛṇomy aham ।udyānāni hi sāya ahne krīḍitvā uparataiḥ naraiḥ ॥2-71-22॥

translations.english: ﻿ I do not see people who with passion used to stroll in the parks early in the morning. I see no cheerfulness in any one.

verses.sloka: समन्तात् विप्रधावद्भिः प्रकाशन्ते मम अन्यदा ।तानि अद्य अनुरुदन्ति इव परित्यक्तानि कामिभिः ॥२-७१-२३॥
verses.transliteration: samantāt vipradhāvadbhiḥ prakāśante mama anyadā ।tāni adya anurudanti iva parityaktāni kāmibhiḥ ॥2-71-23॥

translations.english: ﻿ O charioteer, people full of passion have abandoned the gardens. To me, the city looks like a forest as if weeping.

verses.sloka: अरण्य भूता इव पुरी सारथे प्रतिभाति मे ।न हि अत्र यानैः दृश्यन्ते न गजैः न च वाजिभिः ॥२-७१-२४॥
verses.transliteration: araṇya bhūtā iva purī sārathe pratibhāti me ।na hi atra yānaiḥ dṛśyante na gajaiḥ na ca vājibhiḥ ॥2-71-24॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Important people mounted on elephants or horses are not seen going out of the city or coming in.

verses.sloka: निर्यान्तः वा अभियान्तः वा नर मुख्या यथा पुरम् ।उद्यानानि पुरा भान्ति मत्तप्रमुदितानि च ॥२-७१-२५॥
verses.transliteration: niryāntaḥ vā abhiyāntaḥ vā nara mukhyā yathā puram ।udyānāni purā bhānti mattapramuditāni ca ॥2-71-25॥

translations.english: ﻿ Earlier the gardens used to reverberate with passionate songs of birds--places appropriate for lovers seeking pleasures.

verses.sloka: जनानाम् रतिसम्योगेष्वत्यन्तगुणवन्ति च ।तान्येतान्यद्य वश्यामि निरानन्दानि सर्वशः ॥२-७१-२६॥
verses.transliteration: janānām ratisamyogeṣvatyantaguṇavanti ca ।tānyetānyadya vaśyāmi nirānandāni sarvaśaḥ ॥2-71-26॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Now the trees appear cheerless, the paths are full of dry leaves fallen all over. It appears as if the trees are crying.

verses.sloka: स्रस्तपर्णैरनुपथम् विक्रोशद्भिरिव द्रुमैः ।नाद्यापि श्रूयते शब्दो मत्तानाम् मृगपक्षिणाम् ॥२-७१-२७॥
verses.transliteration: srastaparṇairanupatham vikrośadbhiriva drumaiḥ ।nādyāpi śrūyate śabdo mattānām mṛgapakṣiṇām ॥2-71-27॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ I do not hear in the red tincture of the rising Sun the melodious voices of the freely moving animals and birds.

verses.sloka: सम्रक्ताम् मधुराम् वाणीम् कलम् व्याहरताम् बहु ।चन्दनागुरुसम्पृक्तो धूपसम्मूर्चितोऽतुलः ॥२-७१-२८॥
verses.transliteration: samraktām madhurām vāṇīm kalam vyāharatām bahu ।candanāgurusampṛkto dhūpasammūrcito'tulaḥ ॥2-71-28॥

translations.english: ﻿ Why is it that the incomparable fragrance of sandal and incense that used to fill the nostrils, not blowing now in the prosperous city of Ayodhya?

verses.sloka: प्रवाति पवनः श्रीमान् किम् नु नाद्य यथापुरम् ।भेरीमृदङ्गवीणानाम् कोणसम्घट्टितः पुनः ॥२-७१-२९॥
verses.transliteration: pravāti pavanaḥ śrīmān kim nu nādya yathāpuram ।bherīmṛdaṅgavīṇānām koṇasamghaṭṭitaḥ punaḥ ॥2-71-29॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ Why is it that the sounds of musical instruments like mrudangas and veenas are not heard now? Why is the city filled with melancholy?

verses.sloka: किमद्य शब्दो विरतः सदाऽदीनगतिः पुरा ।अनिष्टानि च पापानि पश्यामि विविधानि च ॥२-७१-३०॥
verses.transliteration: kimadya śabdo virataḥ sadā'dīnagatiḥ purā ।aniṣṭāni ca pāpāni paśyāmi vividhāni ca ॥2-71-30॥

translations.english: ﻿ Since I see many passing, inauspicious, sinful, ugly sights, my mind shrinks.

verses.sloka: निमित्तानि अमनोज्ञानि तेन सीदति ते मनः ।सर्वथा कुशलम् सूत दुर्लभम् मम बन्धुषु ॥२-७१-३१॥
verses.transliteration: nimittāni amanojñāni tena sīdati te manaḥ ।sarvathā kuśalam sūta durlabham mama bandhuṣu ॥2-71-31॥

translations.english: ﻿ I do not see anywhere, O charioteer the wellbeing, of my kinsmen. Hence I feel deluded and my heart is filled with grief.

verses.sloka: तथा ह्यसति सम्मोहे हृदयम् सीदतीव मे ।विषण्णः शान्तहृदयस्त्रस्तः सुलुलितेन्द्रियः ॥२-७१-३२॥
verses.transliteration: tathā hyasati sammohe hṛdayam sīdatīva me ।viṣaṇṇaḥ śāntahṛdayastrastaḥ sululitendriyaḥ ॥2-71-32॥

translations.english: ﻿ Dejected and depressed at heart, with no control over his senses and his mind full of apprehension, Bharata swiftly entered the city of Ayodhya ruled by the Ikshvakus.

verses.sloka: भरतः प्रविवेशाशु पुरीमिक्ष्वाकुपालिताम् ।द्वारेण वैजयन्तेन प्राविशत् श्रान्त वाहनः ॥२-७१-३३॥
verses.transliteration: bharataḥ praviveśāśu purīmikṣvākupālitām ।dvāreṇa vaijayantena prāviśat śrānta vāhanaḥ ॥2-71-33॥

translations.english: ﻿ He entered the city through the gate known as Vaijayanta with his horses exhausted. The doorkeepers stood up and amidst cries of victory followed him in.

verses.sloka: द्वाह्स्थैः उत्थाय विजयम् पृष्टः तैः सहितः ययौ ।स तु अनेक अग्र हृदयो द्वाह्स्थम् प्रत्यर्च्य तम् जनम् ॥२-७१-३४॥
verses.transliteration: dvāhsthaiḥ utthāya vijayam pṛṣṭaḥ taiḥ sahitaḥ yayau ।sa tu aneka agra hṛdayo dvāhstham pratyarcya tam janam ॥2-71-34॥

translations.english: ﻿ Bewildered, that descendant of Raghu (Bharata), reciprocated the greetings of the gatekeepers and then addressed the exhausted charioteer, Ashwapati:

verses.sloka: सूतम् अश्व पतेः क्लान्तम् अब्रवीत् तत्र राघवः ।किमहम् त्वरयानीतः कारणेन विनानघ ॥२-७१-३५॥
verses.transliteration: sūtam aśva pateḥ klāntam abravīt tatra rāghavaḥ ।kimaham tvarayānītaḥ kāraṇena vinānagha ॥2-71-35॥

translations.english: ﻿ O irreproachable one, why was I brought here in haste without any reason? My mind apprehends something inauspicious. I feel indisposed.

verses.sloka: अशुभाशङ्कि हृदयम् शीलम् च पततीव मे ।श्रुता नो यादृशाः पूर्वम् नृपतीनाम् विनाशने ॥२-७१-३६॥
verses.transliteration: aśubhāśaṅki hṛdayam śīlam ca patatīva me ।śrutā no yādṛśāḥ pūrvam nṛpatīnām vināśane ॥2-71-36॥

translations.english: ﻿ O charioteer I now see the very for ebodings I had heard in the past in connection with the death of kings.

verses.sloka: आकाराः तान् अहम् सर्वान् इह पश्यामि सारथे ।सम्मार्जनविहीनानि परुषाण्युपलक्षये ॥२-७१-३७॥
verses.transliteration: ākārāḥ tān aham sarvān iha paśyāmi sārathe ।sammārjanavihīnāni paruṣāṇyupalakṣaye ॥2-71-37॥

translations.english: ﻿﻿ I see the unswept homes of householders standing dirty with doors not closed. There is no beauty anywhere. No one offers oblations (at the time of worship). There is no fragrance of burning incense. The families have no food to eat. The people look cheerless. I see inauspiciousness everywhere.

verses.sloka: असम्यतकवाटानि श्रीविहीनानि सर्वशः ।बलिकर्मविहीनानि धूपसम्मेदनेन च ॥२-७१-३८॥
verses.transliteration: asamyatakavāṭāni śrīvihīnāni sarvaśaḥ ।balikarmavihīnāni dhūpasammedanena ca ॥2-71-38॥

translations.english: ﻿ I see the unswept homes of householders standing dirty with doors not closed. There is no beauty anywhere. No one offers oblations (at the time of worship). There is no fragrance of burning incense. The families have no food to eat. The people look cheerless. I see inauspiciousness everywhere.

verses.sloka: अनाशितकुटुम्बानि प्रभाहीनजनानि च ।अलक्स्मीकानि पश्यामि कुटुम्बिभवनान्यहम् ॥२-७१-३९॥
verses.transliteration: anāśitakuṭumbāni prabhāhīnajanāni ca ।alaksmīkāni paśyāmi kuṭumbibhavanānyaham ॥2-71-39॥

translations.english: ﻿ I see the unswept homes of householders standing dirty with doors not closed. There is no beauty anywhere. No one offers oblations (at the time of worship). There is no fragrance of burning incense. The families have no food to eat. The people look cheerless. I see inauspiciousness everywhere.

verses.sloka: अपेतमाल्यशोभानि असम्मृष्टाजिराणि च ।देवागाराणि शून्यानि न चाभान्ति यथापुरम् ॥२-७१-४०॥
verses.transliteration: apetamālyaśobhāni asammṛṣṭājirāṇi ca ।devāgārāṇi śūnyāni na cābhānti yathāpuram ॥2-71-40॥

translations.english: ﻿ The temples stand devoid of the beauty of floral offerings. The floors of front yards are left unswept and unsmeared. They look deserted, devoid of brightness of the past.

verses.sloka: देवतार्चाः प्रविद्धाश्च यज्ञ्गोष्ठ्यस्तथाविधाः ।माल्यापणेषु राजन्ते नाद्य पण्यानि वा तथा ॥२-७१-४१॥
verses.transliteration: devatārcāḥ praviddhāśca yajñgoṣṭhyastathāvidhāḥ ।mālyāpaṇeṣu rājante nādya paṇyāni vā tathā ॥2-71-41॥

translations.english: ﻿ The offerings to deities have been dispensed with. There are no groups of people performing the usual holy sacrifices. The markets where garlands were sold now stand without them.

verses.sloka: दृश्यन्ते वणिजोऽप्यद्य न यथापूर्वमत्रवै ।ध्यानसम्विग्नहृदयाः नष्टव्यापारयन्त्रिताः ॥२-७१-४२॥
verses.transliteration: dṛśyante vaṇijo'pyadya na yathāpūrvamatravai ।dhyānasamvignahṛdayāḥ naṣṭavyāpārayantritāḥ ॥2-71-42॥

translations.english: ﻿ Even traders seem restrained by the loss of business. They are not seen as before concentrating on their trade.

verses.sloka: देवायतनचैत्येषुदीनाः पक्षिगणास्तथा ॥२-७१-४३॥
verses.transliteration: devāyatanacaityeṣudīnāḥ pakṣigaṇāstathā ॥2-71-43॥

translations.english: ﻿ I see groups of birds frequenting the temples. The sanctuaries appear dispirited. The people in the city, both men and women look dull, emaciated, pitiable with throats choked. Their eyes are filled with tears and minds absorbed in distressing thoughts.

verses.sloka: मलिनम् च अश्रु पूर्ण अक्षम् दीनम् ध्यान परम् कृशम् ।सस्त्री पुम्सम् च पश्यामि जनम् उत्कण्ठितम् पुरे ॥२-७१-४४॥
verses.transliteration: malinam ca aśru pūrṇa akṣam dīnam dhyāna param kṛśam ।sastrī pumsam ca paśyāmi janam utkaṇṭhitam pure ॥2-71-44॥

translations.english: ﻿ I see groups of birds frequenting the temples. The sanctuaries appear dispirited. The people in the city, both men and women look dull, emaciated, pitiable with throats choked. Their eyes are filled with tears and minds absorbed in distressing thoughts.

verses.sloka: इति एवम् उक्त्वा भरतः सूतम् तम् दीन मानसः ।तानि अनिष्टानि अयोध्यायाम् प्रेक्ष्य राज गृहम् ययौ ॥२-७१-४५॥
verses.transliteration: iti evam uktvā bharataḥ sūtam tam dīna mānasaḥ ।tāni aniṣṭāni ayodhyāyām prekṣya rāja gṛham yayau ॥2-71-45॥

translations.english: ﻿ With these words said to the charioteer, Bharata, having seen such ominous sights in Ayodhya, proceeded to the king's palace with a depressed heart.

verses.sloka: ताम् शून्य शृन्ग अटक वेश्म रथ्याम् ।रजो अरुण द्वार कपाट यन्त्राम् ।दृष्ट्वा पुरीम् इन्द्र पुरी प्रकाशाम् ।दुह्खेन सम्पूर्णतरः बभूव ॥२-७१-४६॥
verses.transliteration: tām śūnya śṛnga aṭaka veśma rathyām ।rajo aruṇa dvāra kapāṭa yantrām ।dṛṣṭvā purīm indra purī prakāśām ।duhkhena sampūrṇataraḥ babhūva ॥2-71-46॥

translations.english: ﻿ As he (Bharata) beheld the city of Ayodhya that once had the lustre of the city of Indra, now with its crossroads, houses and highways all deserted, the fittings (nuts and bolts) on the doors red with dust, he was overwhelmed with grief.

verses.sloka: बहूनि पश्यन् मनसो अप्रियाणि ।यानि अन्न्यदा न अस्य पुरे बभूवुः ।अवाक् शिरा दीन मना नहृष्टः ।पितुर् महात्मा प्रविवेश वेश्म ॥२-७१-४७॥
verses.transliteration: bahūni paśyan manaso apriyāṇi ।yāni annyadā na asya pure babhūvuḥ ।avāk śirā dīna manā nahṛṣṭaḥ ।pitur mahātmā praviveśa veśma ॥2-71-47॥

translations.english: Beholding in the city what had never been there at other times, things unwelcome to the mind, the great-souled one entered his father's house with his head bent down, dejected and joyless.
